```{r}
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
# load complete Life Table
Original_lifetable <- read_excel('Complete_LifetimeTable.xlsx', skip=1)

lifeTable2010 <- Original_lifetable %>% select("연령별",
                              "생존자(남자)", "생존자(여자)",
                              "사망자(남자)", "사망자(여자)",
                              "사망확률(남자)", "사망확률(여자)",
                              "기대여명(남자) (년)", "기대여명(여자) (년)",
                              "정지인구(남자)", "정지인구(여자)"
                              )
colnames(lifeTable2010) <- c("Age", "l.0", "l.1", "d.0", "d.1", "q.0", "q.1", "e.0", "e.1", "L.0", "L.1")
lifeTable2010
```

```{r}
lifeTable2010$Age <- gsub("이상", "", lifeTable2010$Age)
lifeTable2010$Age  <- gsub("세", "", lifeTable2010$Age )
lifeTable2010$Age  <- as.integer(lifeTable2010$Age)

lifeTable2010
```

# a) 시계열 도표

### 생존자 수

```{r}
lifeTable2010 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = l.0, color = "Male"), size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = l.1, color = "Female"), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Gender", values = c("Male" = "black", "Female" = "red")
```


# d) 지난 20년간 남녀별 사망률의 변화추이

```{r}
## load complete Life Table
Original2001 <- read_excel('Complete_LifetimeTable2001.xlsx', skip=1)
Original2020 <- read_excel('Complete_LifetimeTable2020.xlsx', skip=1)

process_lifeTable <- function(originalDf){
  lifeTable <- originalDf %>% select("연령별",
                              "생존자(남자)", "생존자(여자)",
                              "사망자(남자)", "사망자(여자)",
                              "사망확률(남자)", "사망확률(여자)",
                              "기대여명(남자) (년)", "기대여명(여자) (년)",
                              "정지인구(남자)", "정지인구(여자)")
  colnames(lifeTable) <- c("Age", "l.0", "l.1", "d.0", "d.1", "q.0", "q.1", "e.0", "e.1", "L.0", "L.1")
  
  lifeTable$Age <- gsub("이상", "", lifeTable$Age)
  lifeTable$Age  <- gsub("세", "", lifeTable$Age )
  lifeTable$Age  <- as.integer(lifeTable$Age)
  return(lifeTable)
}

lifeTable2001 <- process_lifeTable(Original2001)
lifeTable2020 <- process_lifeTable(Original2020)
```

# e) Gompertz 법칙의 성립 여부

```{r}
lifeTable2010_20 <- lifeTable2010 %>% 
  mutate(m.0=d.0/L.0, m.1=d.1/L.1) %>%
  filter(Age>20)

# Gompertz 회귀모형
lm.M <- lm(log(m.0) ~ Age, data = lifeTable2010_20)
lm.F <- lm(log(m.1) ~ Age, data = lifeTable2010_20)

# (a, b)
a_m <- coef(lm.M)[1]
b_m <- coef(lm.M)[2]

a_f <- coef(lm.F)[1]
b_f <- coef(lm.F)[2]

coef.e <- data.frame(
  Sex = c("M", "F"),
  a = round(c(a_m, a_f), 4),
  b = round(c(b_m, b_f), 4)
)

coef.e
```
```{r}
lifeTable2010_20 <- lifeTable2010_20 %>%
  mutate(
    gom_m.0 = exp(a_m + b_m * Age),
    gom_m.1 = exp(a_f + b_f * Age)
  )

g1 <- ggplot(lifeTable2010_20, aes(Age, log(m.0))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "log(m)",
    title = "Age vs log(m) : Male"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

g2 <- ggplot(lifeTable2010_20, aes(Age, log(m.1))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "log(m)",
    title = "Age vs log(m) : Female"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

gridExtra::grid.arrange(g1, g2, ncol = 2)
```



# f) Gompertz Q-Q plot

```{r}
lifeTable2010$l.0[1];lifeTable2010$l.1[1] # l0 값 확인
```

```{r}
# S(x) 계산(x=1, ..., 99)
df_QQ <- lifeTable2010 %>% 
  mutate(S.0=l.0/100000, S.1=l.1/100000) %>% 
  slice(2:100) %>% 
  select(Age, S.0, S.1) %>%
  mutate(QQ0=log(-log(S.0)), QQ1=log(-log(S.1)))

df_QQ %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age))+
  geom_point(aes(y=QQ0), color='pink')+
  geom_point(aes(y=QQ1), color='darkgreen') +
  geom_smooth(aes(y=QQ0), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "orange")+
  geom_smooth(aes(y=QQ1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkblue") +
  labs(title="Q-Q plot", y='QQ') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) 
```

```{r}
QQ1 <- df_QQ %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age,y=QQ0))+
  geom_point(color='black')+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "orange")+
  labs(title="Q-Q plot : Male", y='QQ') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) 

QQ2 <- df_QQ %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=QQ1))+
  geom_point(color='black')+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "orange")+
  labs(title="Q-Q plot : Female", y='QQ') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) 

grid.arrange(QQ1, QQ2, ncol=2)
```
```{r}
# X > 40
QQ3 <- df_QQ %>%

```
```{r}
df_estimate <- df_QQ %>%slice(42:100)

# 회귀모형 
lmf.M <- lm(Age ~ QQ0, data=df_estimate)
lmf.F <- lm(Age ~ QQ1, data=df_estimate)

# (mu, sigma)
res1.f <- data.frame(Sex=c("M", "F"),
           mu = round(c(summary(lmf.M)$coefficients[1,1], summary(lmf.F)$coefficients[1,1]),4),
           sigma = round(c(summary(lmf.M)$coefficients[2,1], summary(lmf.F)$coefficients[2,1]),4)
           )
res1.f
```

```{r}
# (a, b)
res2.f <- res1.f %>% 
  mutate(b=1/sigma, a=log(b)-mu/sigma) %>%
  select(Sex, a,b)


# 결과 비교 : e) v.s. f)
merge(coef.e, res2.f, by='Sex')
```

# g) 최대수명 계산

```{r}
# 한계 수명
df_g <- lifeTable2010 %>% slice(22:101) %>% select(Age, q.0, q.1)
lmg.M <- lm(log(q.0)~Age, data=df_g)
lmg.F <- lm(log(q.1)~Age, data=df_g)

res1.g <- data.frame(Sex=c("M", "F"),
           a = round(c(summary(lmg.M)$coefficients[1,1], summary(lmg.F)$coefficients[1,1]),4),
           b = round(c(summary(lmg.M)$coefficients[2,1], summary(lmg.F)$coefficients[2,1]),4)
           )

x_bar.M <- -res1.g$a[res1.g$Sex=="M"]/res1.g$b[res1.g$Sex=="M"]
x_bar.F <- -res1.g$a[res1.g$Sex=="F"]/res1.g$b[res1.g$Sex=="F"]

x_bar.M; x_bar.F
```

```{r}
# 최대 수명
mu.M <- res1.f$mu[1]; sigma.M <- res1.f$sigma[1]
mu.F <- res1.f$mu[2]; sigma.F <- res1.f$sigma[2]

res2.g <- data.frame(n=c(100000, 500000, 1000000, 100000000, 6000000000)) %>%
  mutate(xn.M = mu.M+sigma.M*(log(log(n+1))),
         xn.F = mu.F+sigma.F*(log(log(n+1))))

res2.g
```
